fields.title: LuxeShop-ECommerce
fields.subtitle: Cloud-Native E-Commerce & DevOps Pipeline
fields.outcome: Containerised full-stack e-commerce platform orchestrated on Kubernetes with Terraform AWS provisioning, Jenkins CI/CD, and Prometheus/Grafana observability.
fields.description: Multi-tier e-commerce system pairing an Nginx-fronted web app and Node.js/Express API with MongoDB, automated via Jenkins pipelines, Terraform IaC, Docker, Kubernetes, and Prometheus/Grafana metrics.
details: Containerised Nginx frontend and Node.js/Express backend services with Docker and Docker Compose
Defined Kubernetes deployment manifests and Jenkins CI/CD automation pipelines
Provisioned AWS ECR and EC2 infrastructure using Terraform IaC
Exposed backend /metrics endpoints scraped by Prometheus and visualised in Grafana

fields.title: buyX
fields.subtitle: Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform
fields.outcome: Migrated a legacy Django storefront to Next.js 15 SSR, cutting initial page-load latency and unifying customer and distributor workflows.
fields.description: Dual-sided e-commerce platform for customers and distributors with product catalog browsing, inventory management, order tracking, and OTP/payment workflows.
details: Migrated legacy Django-based storefront to Next.js 15 for faster rendering and modularity
Built responsive UI components using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
Integrated Razorpay checkout and Twilio SMS/OTP notifications
Designed relational schemas and REST endpoints backed by Prisma ORM and MySQL

fields.title: CloudDataGuard
fields.subtitle: MongoDB Data Redundancy Removal System
fields.outcome: Intercepts duplicate file and record ingestion before storage using SHA-256 cryptographic checksums, B-Tree unique indexes, and MongoDB $jsonSchema validation.
fields.description: Cloud storage optimisation backend built with FastAPI and MongoDB that enforces dual-layer schema validation and cryptographic deduplication with a live inspection dashboard.
details: Implemented FastAPI + PyMongo CRUD endpoints with Pydantic and MongoDB engine-level $jsonSchema validation
Prevented duplicate storage writes using SHA-256 content hashes and B-Tree unique indexes
Logged deduplication events across decoupled records and duplicate_logs collections
Verified query execution and API behaviour with MongoDB explain() and pytest

fields.title: PhishScope
fields.subtitle: AI Email Threat Detection & Forensics Platform
fields.outcome: Combines RFC header forensics, SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment checks, 4 ML classifiers, infrastructure correlation, and a Gemini briefing assistant in-memory with zero disk retention.
fields.description: Full-stack phishing forensics workbench for SOC teams and researchers, analysing raw .eml files and headers across authentication, URL, graph, and ML pipelines.
details: Built TypeScript/Express analysis pipeline reconstructing SMTP hops and transit deltas
Implemented SPF/DKIM/DMARC provenance alignment checks and Punycode/IDN URL inspection
Trained and integrated 4 classifiers (Logistic Regression, Linear SVM, XGBoost, Transformer TF-IDF)
Added passive DNS correlation graphs, Gemini 5-pillar investigation briefs, and PDF/Excel/JSON export

fields.title: Smart Resource Predictor
fields.subtitle: AI-Based Predictive Web App
fields.outcome: Achieved 97% forecast accuracy for energy and water usage; exposed via a Flask web app with interactive Chart.js dashboards.
fields.description: Predictive analytics web application combining ensemble ML models and time-series MySQL storage to forecast sustainable energy and water consumption.
details: Combined Decision Tree, XGBoost, and Neural Networks (TensorFlow) for ensemble forecasting
Built a Flask web interface with interactive Chart.js forecast visualisations
Engineered temporal features for energy and water consumption optimisation
Persisted and queried historical time-series datasets in MySQL

fields.title: EDA – E-Commerce Sales
fields.subtitle: Exploratory Data Analysis
fields.outcome: Analysed 7,200+ e-commerce transactions to isolate top revenue drivers, seasonality patterns, and regional performance.
fields.description: End-to-end exploratory data analysis notebook uncovering sales velocity, customer behaviour, and regional revenue patterns across 7,200+ transactions.
details: Cleaned, normalised, and ran correlation analysis across 7,200+ transaction records
Generated visual breakdowns and trend plots using Matplotlib and Seaborn
Identified top revenue categories and underperforming regions

fields.title: Top 500 Crypto Coins
fields.subtitle: Power BI Dashboard
fields.outcome: Built an interactive ETL + Power BI workbook tracking market cap dominance, volume, and price movements across 500 cryptocurrencies.
fields.description: Self-service Power BI analytics dashboard built on a clean ETL pipeline to compare market caps, 24h changes, and liquidity metrics across the top 500 coins.
details: Extracted, cleaned, and modelled market data for 500 cryptocurrencies in Power BI
Designed interactive slicers, market-cap treemaps, and trend KPIs
Packaged a reusable .pbix report for self-service exploration
